headline: Entel agrees to sell Peruvian operations to Millicom for $1.71 billion
summary: Chilean telecommunications company Entel agreed to sell 100% of its Peruvian subsidiary to Luxembourg-based Millicom for $1.714 billion. Entel CEO Antonio Büchi stated that value creation opportunities in Peru had become limited compared to the purchase offer.
why: Millicom and Entel are prominent Latin American telecom operators restructuring their regional operational footprints.

impacts.name: Entel
impacts.why: Entel secured a $1.714 billion cash deal to divest its Peruvian business unit.
